notes.title: v1.0.3 [patch 3]
notes.content:
ADDITION
- Added a general background throughout the adventure to make the environment more detailed.

CHANGE
- Hexagons scattered outside the playable area now have a shadow.

BUG FIXES
- Proofreading of texts in English.
- When switching from keyboard or gamepad to mouse on any menu button, a left click wouldn’t register as a mouse click unless the mouse was moved first — the button wouldn’t be clickable otherwise.
- If you click on a button with the mouse that navigates to another menu, then go back using the gamepad, the selection highlight (pink outline) wouldn’t return to the correct button.
- When clicking on menu buttons with the mouse, you could sometimes briefly see the selection highlight (pink outline) move, as it was still reacting to gamepad behavior.

notes.title: v1.0.2 [patch 2]
notes.content:
BUG FIXES
- The Discord link takes you to a functional channel.
- If we open the pause menu when the interface menu is open, when we close the pause menu we now recover the control of the character.
- In the controls menu the pink line for the D-Pad (Move 2) on the gamepad are now visible and the other small pink line has been resized.

ADDITION
- The Steam Cloud is now activated.

notes.title: v1.0.1 [patch 1]
notes.content:
ADDITION
- A Discord link have been added in the main menu.

OPTIMIZATION
- The size of the textures has been decreased, they are now more optimized.
